corrections.text: The article states that Lyzr "used a predecessor agent called Agent Sam" for its 2025 Series A, implying Agent Sam was retired in favor of the current Series B agent, SivaClaw. The cited sources do not support that succession. Only TechCrunch uses the name "SivaClaw," attributing it to the current Series B outreach. The Next Web instead attributes that same current-round activity -- fielding questions from 130-plus investors and drafting investment memos -- to an agent it calls "Agent Sam," the same name it and Lyzr's own blog use for the agent that ran the 2025 Series A. The sources conflict on the current round's agent name, and Machine Herald could not independently confirm whether "SivaClaw" and "Agent Sam" refer to the same system under different names or are separate agents.
